title: Impact of Recent Rise in Rental Prices of Commercial Properties on Singapore’s Competitiveness as Business Destination
what_it_is: Impact of Recent Rise in Rental Prices of Commercial Properties on Singapore’s Competitiveness as Business Destination

sections.label: Office rental index and supply
sections.summary: Office rents rose about 1.35% yearly over three years, stay below 2008 and 2015 peaks, with over 530,000 square metres completing between 2023 and 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The rental index of office spaces in Singapore has increased by an average of about 1.35% per annum in the last three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: While rental for office spaces is higher than the pre-pandemic level, it remains below historical peaks in 2008 and 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Between 2023 and 2025, more than 530,000 square metres of office space is expected to be completed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This is about 40% higher, compared to the past three years combined, and can help to cater to the demand and moderate rent increases over time.

sections.label: Jurong Lake District mixed-use site
sections.summary: In December the Government announced a Jurong Lake District mixed-use site potentially yielding about 150,000 square metres of commercial space, released via the confirmed list in June 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Just a few months ago, in December last year, the Government announced a mixed-use site at Jurong Lake District that is potentially yielding about 150,000 square metres of commercial space and that will be released via the confirmed list in June 2023.

sections.label: IOI Central Boulevard completion
sections.summary: This year, the IOI Central Boulevard in the Central Business District will be completed, yielding 139,000 square metres.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In the Central Business District (CBD) area, for example, this year, we will see the completion of the IOI Central Boulevard and that will yield 139,000 square metres.

sections.label: 530,000 square metres and EIU ranking
sections.summary: Shaw Towers Redevelopment and Solitaire on Cecil complete in 2025, giving 530,000 square metres of gross floor area over three years, while Singapore retains the EIU's best business environment for 15 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Two years later, 2025, Shaw Towers Redevelopment, 44,000 square metres; and two years later as well, Solitaire on Cecil.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, I just want to give the Member assurance that we are seeing the completion of a combined gross floor area (GFA) of 530,000 square metres over the next three years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Today, our city state continues to be one of the most competitive economies of the world and this is attested to by the recent EIU ranking which indicated that Singapore has retained the position of having the world's best business environment for 15 years.
